concepts.def: Investigation of artists, movements and works that informs and contextualises a student's own practical development.
First-hand investigation through gallery visits, life drawing or photography, generating original source material.
Investigation drawn from existing sources such as books, online archives and reproductions, supporting primary work.
Written reflection alongside visual work, analysing intentions, processes, influences and outcomes for assessment.
Examination of a work's historical, social and cultural conditions of production, beyond purely formal qualities.
Extended A-Level component in which students develop a self-directed enquiry supported by a written element of around 1000-3000 words.
